units.title: Hello, Gogo!
units.theme: Gogo introduces himself to Peter and talks about school items and favorite foods.（Gogo 向 Peter 自我介紹，並聊到學校用品與喜愛的食物。）

patterns.english: What's this? / It's a...
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問與回答近處的單數物品是什麼。
patterns.example: 1. What's this? It's a pencil.2. What's this? It's a notebook.

patterns.english: What do you like? / I like...
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問並表達喜愛的食物或事物。
patterns.example: 1. What do you like? I like steak.2. What do you like? I like chicken.

units.title: They're big.
units.theme: Characters describe themselves and others using adjectives of size, mood, and temperature.（角色們使用描述大小、心情和溫度的形容詞來描繪自己與他人。）

patterns.english: Subject + be + adjective.
patterns.chinese: 用於描述人物、動物或事物的狀態與特徵。
patterns.example: 1. We're happy.2. They're cold.

units.title: Do you like baseball?
units.theme: Friends ask each other about their sports preferences and invite each other to play.（朋友們互相詢問對球類運動的喜好並邀請一同玩耍。）

patterns.english: Do you like...? / Yes, I do. (No, I don't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問他人是否喜愛某項運動並做回答。
patterns.example: 1. Do you like tennis? No, I don't. I like badminton.2. Do you like soccer? Yes, I do.

units.title: What's that?
units.theme: Identifying household items and their colors from a distance in a bedroom.（在房間中指認與詢問遠處的家用品及其顏色。）

patterns.english: What's that? / It's a...
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問遠處的單數物品是什麼並回答。
patterns.example: 1. What's that? It's a pink lamp.2. What's that? It's a blue desk.

patterns.english: Is that a...? / Yes, it is. (No, it isn't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於確認遠處的單數物品是否為某物並回答。
patterns.example: 1. Is that a brown door? Yes, it is.2. Is that a black pillow? No, it isn't.

units.title: What are these?
units.theme: Asking about and identifying different kinds of plural fruits nearby.（詢問並指認近處各種複數水果。）

patterns.english: What are these? / They're...
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問近處的多個複數物品或水果是什麼並回答。
patterns.example: 1. What are these? They're pears.2. What are these? They're grapes.

patterns.english: Are these...? / Yes, they are. (No, they aren't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於確認近處的多個複數物品/水果是否為某物並回答。
patterns.example: 1. Are these peaches? No, they aren't. They're oranges.2. Are these grapes? Yes, they are.

units.title: Where's my book?
units.theme: Searching for lost clothes and personal items by describing their spatial positions.（尋找遺失的衣物或個人用品，並描述其確切的空間位置。）

patterns.english: Where's my [singular]? / It's [prep.] the...
patterns.chinese: 用於尋找與回答單數物品的位置。
patterns.example: 1. Where's my skirt? It's on the bed.2. Where's my eraser? It's under the desk.

patterns.english: Where are my [plural]? / They're [prep.] the...
patterns.chinese: 用於尋找與回答複數物品的位置。
patterns.example: 1. Where are my socks? They're under the pillow.2. Where are my pants? They're on the bed.

words.example: My jacket is on the chair.

units.title: What time is it?
units.theme: Asking about and telling the exact hours of the clock throughout the day.（詢問與告知一天中的整點時間。）

patterns.english: What time is it? / It's... o'clock.
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問時間並以整點回答。
patterns.example: 1. What time is it? It's eleven o'clock.2. What time is it? It's five o'clock.

patterns.english: Is it... o'clock? / Yes, it is. (No, it isn't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於確認是否為某個整點時間並做回答。
patterns.example: 1. Is it twelve o'clock? Yes, it is.2. Is it one o'clock? No, it isn't. It's two o'clock.

units.title: How many are there?
units.theme: Counting and describing the quantities of fruits and various objects.（數數並描述水果及各式物品的數量。）

patterns.english: How many... are there? / There are...
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問複數物品的數量並進行回答。
patterns.example: 1. How many cherries are there? There are twenty.2. How many strawberries are there? There are thirteen strawberries.

units.title: Do you have plates?
units.theme: Asking and answering questions about tablewares and household possessions.（詢問並回答關於餐具與個人物品的擁有狀況。）

patterns.english: Do you have...? / Yes, we do. (No, we don't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問第二人稱或複數主詞是否擁有某物。
patterns.example: 1. Do you have forks? Yes, we do.2. Do you have spoons? No, we don't.

patterns.english: Does she/he have...? / Yes, she/he does. (No, she/he doesn't.)
patterns.chinese: 用於詢問第三人稱單數主詞是否擁有某物。
patterns.example: 1. Does she have napkins? No, she doesn't. She has bowls.2. Does he have knives? Yes, he does.

units.title: Hi, Gogo!
units.desc: 本單元引導學生與 Gogo 進行問候，並學習描述身體感受、家族成員與日常文具。
units.theme: Greeting Gogo and identifying people's feelings, family members, and school items.（問候與辨識狀態：與 Gogo 問候，並描述生理感受、家族成員與學校文具。）

patterns.english: Are you [adjective]? / Yes, I am. (No, I'm not.)
patterns.chinese: 你感到...嗎？／是的，我是。（不，我不是。）用於詢問並回答對方的生理感受或狀態。
patterns.example: 1. Are you hungry? - Yes, I am.2. Are you thirsty? - No, I'm not.

patterns.english: Who's she? / She's my [relationship].
patterns.chinese: 她是誰？／她是我的...。用於詢問並回答第三者（女性成員）的身份與關係。
patterns.example: 1. Who's she? - She's my grandmother.2. Who's he? - He's my grandfather.

patterns.english: What's that? / It's a [noun].
patterns.chinese: 那是什麼？／它是一部/個...。用於詢問並回答單數的事物。
patterns.example: 1. What's that? - It's a stapler.2. Is it a jet? - No, it isn't. It's a bird.

units.title: What day is it today?
units.desc: 本單元引導學生認識星期，並學習描述在特定星期進行的休閒與樂器活動。
units.theme: Asking and answering about the days of the week and daily activities.（詢問與回答星期與日常活動：詢問今天星期幾，並描述在特定星期進行的活動。）

patterns.english: What day is it today? / It's [Day].
patterns.chinese: 今天星期幾？／今天是星期...。用於詢問並回答當天的星期。
patterns.example: 1. What day is it today? - It's Monday.2. What day is it today? - It's Sunday.

patterns.english: What do you do on [Day]? / I [action] on [Day].
patterns.chinese: 你在星期...做什麼？／我在星期...做...。用於詢問與描述在特定星期的例行活動或才藝。
patterns.example: 1. What do you do on Monday? - I play the violin on Monday.2. What do you do on Tuesday? - I play badminton on Tuesday.

words.example: I play the violin on Monday.
Do you play soccer on Wednesday?
I play the piano on Thursday.
What day is it today? It's Saturday.
There are seven days in a week.

units.title: Can I have a balloon?
units.desc: 本單元學習有禮貌地請求許可（借用或索取日常物品），並給予適當的回應。
units.theme: Asking for permission and responding to requests for having or borrowing everyday items.（請求允許與回應：學習如何有禮貌地請求允許取得或借用日常物品，以及如何給予或拒絕許可。）

patterns.english: Can I have a/an [noun], please? / Sure. Here you are.
patterns.chinese: 我可以拿/要一個...嗎？／當然可以，拿去吧。用於有禮貌地向他人請求給予某物，並同意給予。
patterns.example: 1. Can I have a peach? - Sure. Here you are.2. Can I have a yellow balloon, please?

patterns.english: Can I borrow your [noun]? / No. Sorry.
patterns.chinese: 我可以借用你的...嗎？／不行，抱歉。用於有禮貌地向他人借用物品，並在無法出借時給予委婉回應。
patterns.example: 1. Can I borrow your ruler? - No. Sorry.2. Can I borrow your pen? - Sure. Here you are.

units.title: Do you like science?
units.desc: 本單元引導學生討論學校學科，並表達自己或他人對不同科目的喜好。
units.theme: Asking about and expressing likes, dislikes, and school subjects.（表達學科喜好：詢問並表達自己或他人對學校科目的喜歡或不喜歡。）

patterns.english: Do you like [subject]? / Yes, I do. (No, I don't.)
patterns.chinese: 你喜歡...（科目）嗎？／是的，我喜歡。（不，我不喜歡。）用於詢問並回答對某學科的喜好。
patterns.example: 1. Do you like math? - Yes, I do.2. Do you like science? - No, I don't.

patterns.english: What subjects do you like? / I like [subject 1] and [subject 2].
patterns.chinese: 你喜歡哪些學科？／我喜歡...和...。用於詢問並具體列出喜愛的學校科目。
patterns.example: 1. What subjects do you like, Gogo? - I like art and history.2. What subjects do they like? - They like P.E.

units.title: What do they want?
units.desc: 本單元探討各種玩具與休閒物品，學習詢問與描述自己、他人及複數主詞想要的物品。
units.theme: Asking about and expressing wants and wishes of oneself and others.（表達想要與需求：詢問與表達自己、他人（單數/複數）想要得到的玩具或物品。）

patterns.english: Do you want [item]? / Yes, please. (No, thank you.)
patterns.chinese: 你想要...嗎？／是的，請給我。（不，謝謝。）用於詢問並回答自身的意願或需求。
patterns.example: 1. Do you want a guitar? - Yes, please.2. Do you want a game? - No, thank you.

patterns.english: Does she/he want [item]? / Yes, she/he does. (No, she/he doesn't.)
patterns.chinese: 她/他想要...嗎？／是的，她/他想要。（不，她/他不想。）用於詢問並回答第三人稱單數的意願與需求。
patterns.example: 1. Does she want a doll? - No, she doesn't.2. Does he want a toy car? - Yes, he does.

patterns.english: What do they want? / They want [item].
patterns.chinese: 他們想要什麼？／他們想要...。用於詢問並說明複數第三人稱想要的物品。
patterns.example: 1. What do they want? - They want a computer game.2. What do you want? - I want a doll.

words.example: Does he want a toy car?

units.title: Where are my glasses?
units.desc: 本單元引導學生使用常見的空間介系詞（如 behind, next to 等），詢問並說明個人隨身物品的所在位置。
units.theme: Asking about and describing the location of everyday things using prepositions.（詢問與描述位置：使用空間介系詞（在...後面、在...前面等）詢問並說明日常用品的位置。）

patterns.english: Where's my [item]? / It's [preposition] the [furniture].
patterns.chinese: 我的...（單數）在哪裡？／它在...的（後面/前面/旁邊）。用於詢問並描述單數物品的位置。
patterns.example: 1. Where's my wallet? - It's behind the sofa.2. Where's my white sock? - It's behind the door.

patterns.english: Where are my [items]? / They're [preposition] the [furniture].
patterns.chinese: 我的...（複數）們在哪裡？／它們在...的...。用於詢問並描述複數或對稱物品（如眼鏡、襪子們）的位置。
patterns.example: 1. Where are my glasses? - They're in front of the bookcase.2. Where are they? - They're on the floor.

words.example: The sock is in the closet.
They are in front of the bookcase.
The clock is next to the box.
The dog is in front of the bookcase.

units.title: What are you doing?
units.desc: 本單元引導學生學習現在進行式（Present Progressive），詢問並具體描述他人當下正在進行的活動。
units.theme: Asking about and describing what people are doing using the present progressive tense.（描述當下正在進行的活動：使用現在進行式詢問與描述人們當下正在做的事情。）

patterns.english: What's she/he doing? / She's/He's [action-ing].
patterns.chinese: 她/他正在做什麼？／她/他正在...。用於詢問並描述第三人稱單數（女性/男性）當下進行的動作。
patterns.example: 1. What's she doing? - She's writing.2. What's he doing? - He's reading.

patterns.english: What are they doing? / They're [action-ing].
patterns.chinese: 他們正在做什麼？／他們正在...。用於詢問並描述複數第三人稱當下的活動。
patterns.example: 1. What are they doing? - They're painting.2. What are you doing? - We're shopping, Gogo.

units.title: This is his body.
units.desc: 本單元引導學生認識人體的主要外觀構造，並能聽懂祈使句指令、做出相對應的身體動作。
units.theme: Identifying parts of the body and responding to commands or instructions.（辨識身體部位與指令：辨識身體各部位名稱，並對身體動作的命令或指令做出反應。）

patterns.english: Touch your [body part]! / Close (Open) your [body part]!
patterns.chinese: 觸碰你的...！／閉上（張開）你的...！祈使句句型，用於發出與執行身體感官的動作指令。
patterns.example: 1. Touch your nose!2. Close your eyes!

units.title: Whose bag is this?
units.desc: 本單元引導學生學習所有格代名詞與名字所有格，詢問並辨識日常隨身物品究竟是「誰的」。
units.theme: Asking about and identifying ownership of everyday items using possessive pronouns.（詢問與辨識物品所有權：使用所有格代名詞或所有格，詢問並辨識日常用品是誰的所有物。）

patterns.english: Whose [item] is this? / It's [possessive pronoun/noun's].
patterns.chinese: 這是誰的...？／它是（我的/他的/Jenny的）。用於詢問並回答單數物品的所有權。
patterns.example: 1. Whose skateboard is this? - It's my skateboard.2. Whose ruler is this? - It's Jenny's.
